text:
Hi,

Claire here, from Nora Lanelle. About six weeks since your order shipped; by now the piece is worn in and you know the fit, which makes the second order the easy one: same size, no guessing, while the sizes are still there to choose from.

Three pieces cut for one palette, worn together or apart: the Double-Breasted Wool Coat, the Ribbed Turtleneck Knit, the Carpenter Jeans. If one of them is yours, this week beats next; the Autumn Sale is on, and sizes go before it ends.

Shipping is on us from $150; from $250 it ships insured, priority dispatch, free. Thirty days at home, easy returns, on everything.

The three pieces, together on one page:
https://nora-lanelle.com/collections/look-town-coat

Take care,
Claire
Nora Lanelle

PS: Same size as last time is the right call; between sizes, take both and send back the one that doesn't fit, easy returns. Questions, or anything not right with the order: write to support@nora-lanelle.com before you call your bank; answered in one to two business days.
